id: \bWelcome to the Battle Factory.
en: \bWelcome to the Battle Factory.
it: \bBenvenuto all'Fabbrica Lotta.

id: \bWould you like to participate in a double battle?
en: \bWould you like to participate in a double battle?
it: \bVuoi partecipare a una lotta in doppio?

id: \bPlease come this way.
en: \bPlease come this way.
it: \bDa questa parte, prego.

id: \bCome back another time.
en: \bCome back another time.
it: \bTorna un'altra volta.

id: \bCongratulations for winning.
en: \bCongratulations for winning.
it: \bCongratulazioni per la vittoria.

id: \bI will take your rental Pokémon back and return your own Pokémon.
en: \bI will take your rental Pokémon back and return your own Pokémon.
it: \bRiprendo i Pokémon a noleggio e ti restituisco i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bPlease take this prize.
en: \bPlease take this prize.
it: \bTi prego, accetta questo premio.

id: \bYou have no room for it. At least you won, though.
en: \bYou have no room for it.  At least you won, though.
it: \bNon hai spazio per tenerlo.  Almeno hai vinto, però.

id: \bWould you like to record your last battle?
en: \bWould you like to record your last battle?
it: \bVuoi registrare la tua ultima lotta?

id: \se[expfull]The battle was recorded.
en: \se[expfull]The battle was recorded.
it: \se[expfull]La lotta è stata registrata.

id: Your results will be recorded.\wtnp[15]
en: Your results will be recorded.\wtnp[15]
it: I tuoi risultati verranno registrati.\wtnp[15]

id: \bThanks for playing.
en: \bThanks for playing.
it: \bGrazie per aver partecipato.

id: \bWe've been waiting for you. Please come this way.
en: \bWe've been waiting for you.  Please come this way.
it: \bTi stavamo aspettando.  Da questa parte, prego.

id: \bExcuse me, but you didn't save before finishing your challenge last time.
en: \bExcuse me, but you didn't save before finishing your challenge last time.
it: \bScusa, ma l'ultima volta non hai salvato prima di terminare la sfida.

id: \bSorry, but your challenge has been canceled.
en: \bSorry, but your challenge has been canceled.
it: \bSpiacente, ma la tua sfida è stata annullata.

id: In a Battle Swap event, you may use only three Pokémon.
en: In a Battle Swap event, you may use only three Pokémon.
it: Nella sfida Scambio Lotta puoi usare solo tre Pokémon.

id: Whether you're renting or swapping, your team may not have two or more of the same Pokémon.
en: Whether you're renting or swapping, your team may not have two or more of the same Pokémon.
it: Che tu stia noleggiando o scambiando, la tua squadra non può avere due o più esemplari dello stesso Pokémon.

id: You may swap Pokémon only with the Trainer you have just defeated.
en: You may swap Pokémon only with the Trainer you have just defeated.
it: Puoi scambiare Pokémon solo con l'Allenatore che hai appena sconfitto.

id: You may swap for only those Pokémon used by the beaten Trainer.
en: You may swap for only those Pokémon used by the beaten Trainer.
it: Puoi ricevere in cambio solo i Pokémon usati dall'Allenatore sconfitto.

id: After every battle you win, you may swap for one of your defeated opponent's Pokémon.
en: After every battle you win, you may swap for one of your defeated opponent's Pokémon.
it: Dopo ogni lotta vinta, puoi scambiare un tuo Pokémon con uno di quelli dell'avversario sconfitto.

id: You will not be able to swap Pokémon with the last Trainer in the event.
en: You will not be able to swap Pokémon with the last Trainer in the event.
it: Non potrai scambiare Pokémon con l'ultimo Allenatore della sfida.

id: There are two key points to be aware of when swapping Pokémon.
en: There are two key points to be aware of when swapping Pokémon.
it: Ci sono due punti chiave da tenere presenti quando scambi i Pokémon.

id: First, when swapping, you can't check the stats of the Pokémon you are about to receive.
en: First, when swapping, you can't check the stats of the Pokémon you are about to receive.
it: Primo: durante lo scambio non puoi controllare le statistiche del Pokémon che stai per ricevere.

id: Second, the Pokémon in your team are lined up in sequence, depending on the order in which you rented them.
en: Second, the Pokémon in your team are lined up in sequence, depending on the order in which you rented them.
it: Secondo: i Pokémon della tua squadra sono disposti in sequenza, in base all'ordine in cui li hai noleggiati.

id: This sequence remains unchanged even when swaps are made.
en: This sequence remains unchanged even when swaps are made.
it: Questa sequenza resta invariata anche dopo gli scambi.

id: There is no battle recorded.
en: There is no battle recorded.
it: Non è stata registrata nessuna lotta.

en: \bWould you like to participate in a single battle?
it: \bVuoi partecipare a una lotta singola?
